build_RPNHead: build an RPNHead instance with custom in_channels and num_convs for object detection proposal generation
run_forward_single: run forward_single on a single scale level feature tensor to get cls scores and bbox predictions
calculate_loss_by_feat: calculate the RPN classification and regression loss from cls_scores and bbox_preds against ground truth instances
predict_proposals_single: predict object proposals from multi-level cls scores and bbox predictions using _predict_by_feat_single with NMS post-processing
post_process_bboxes: post process detection results with NMS filtering, score thresholding, and box rescaling using _bbox_post_process
